threadDescriptions.grandfather-interview: Prepare and conduct a Polish audio interview about grandfather's childhood
threadDescriptions.polish-case-drills: Practice Polish noun cases in a weekly adult study circle
threadDescriptions.kitchen-renovation: Choose and install replacement kitchen cabinet handles

items.text: Kitchen handles: photograph the hole spacing before ordering. The current brass finish is flaking.
Saturday Polish circle homework: six sentences with instrumental endings. Olek will check the plural forms.
For Grandpa's Polish interview, begin with his school kitchen story. Aim for ten minutes, with permission to pause whenever he wants.
96 mm between the kitchen handle holes. Need twelve replacements, including the narrow drawer.
Case-drill sheet: I keep using the singular ending after two friends. Circle the noun and rewrite each example aloud.
Grandpa wants the interview in the morning; he gets tired after lunch. Ask about the school cook before moving to the railway job.
Return the twelve handles: I measured the outside width. Actual screw centres are 64 mm, checked against the paper rubbing.
Olek's audio feedback on my instrumental exercise: endings mostly right, stress misplaced in the second example. Repeat slowly, then naturally.
The kitchen one first, then the difficult bit.
items.rationale: Could refer to interview story or cabinet work.

items.text: Interview question card, large print: Who worked in the school kitchen? What did you carry home? Leave room beneath each for a follow-up.
Matte nickel handle sample looks less yellow under our kitchen light. Try it on the drawer before buying the other eleven.

I brought Grandpa's interview questions to the Polish circle. We will correct the noun cases together, keep the corrected question cards for recording day, and add the mistakes to my weekly drill sheet.
items.rationale: Directly advances both interview cards and grammar drills.

items.text: Study circle moved from plurals to place expressions. Homework is describing a room; my cabinet handles can stay out of the sentences.
items.rationale: Grammar homework with incidental hardware mention.

items.text: Recorded interview test: fridge hum overwhelms Grandpa's voice in the kitchen. Move the recorder and chairs to the sitting room.
Six location sentences read without looking. Olek marked only the last case ending; rewrite that one before Saturday.
Kitchen handle order confirmed: twelve at 64 mm, matte nickel. Old screws are too long for the new fittings.
Grandpa recording completed: fourteen minutes about school meals, seven about his first job. He asked me to cut the neighbour's surname from the family copy.
Nickel sample / Saturday / ask Olek?
items.rationale: Fragment mixes cues without a clear action or context.

items.text: All kitchen handles installed. Put two spare short screws in the labelled fittings bag.
Family interview export checked with Grandpa: surname removed, his school cook story retained. Send the audio privately to his daughters after he approves this cut.
